decisions.reason: A door lever handle family is core to the firm's established range, and such families usually stay in the catalogue for many years once launched.
This door handle design was still on the website in 2019 and fits the core offer, though design handles do get pruned from time to time, so the drop risk is moderate.
The L700 electronic access system with its unique light technology supports the firm's strategic move toward digital building organization, so the firm is likely to keep and develop it.
